title: Maridebart Cafraglutide versus Placebo in Participants with Type 2 Diabetes, Inadequately Controlled with Basal Insulin
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial Comparing the Efficacy and Safety of Maridebart Cafraglutide versus Placebo in Participants with Type 2 Diabetes, Inadequately Controlled with Basal Insulin
summary: Main objective: To determine whether maridebart cafraglutide is superior to plecebo for improvement in glycemic control inparticipants with Type 2 Diabetes treated with basal insulin
conditions: Type 2 Diabetes, Inadequately Controlled with Basal Insulin
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Signed informed consent before initiation of any trial-specific activities/procedures as described in Section 11.3 of the protocol which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in the protocol.
2. Age ≥ 18 years (or ≥ legal age within the country if it is older than 18 years) at the time of signing informed consent.
3. Documented diagnosis of T2DM based on the World Health Organization classification.
4. HbA1c of ≥ 7.0% (53.0 mmol/mol) and ≤ 10.5% (91.0 mmol/mol) at screening.
5. Stable treatment of T2DM with daily basal insulin (glargine U-100, glargine U-300 or degludec U-100 or degludec U-200,> 0.25 U/kg/day or > 20 U/day), with or without metformin (≥ 1500 mg/day, or maximum tolerated dose as per investigator judgment) with or without an SGLT-2 inhibitor, for at least 90 days before randomization. Note 1: Basal insulin dose is considered stable when all doses during the 90 day period before randomization are within the range defined by ± 20% of the insulin dose at the start of the screening period.
6. BMI ≥ 23 kg/m2 at screening.
7. Participants of childbearing potential must use protocol-specified contraception (as defined in Section 5.4.2.1), during treatment and for an additional after the last dose of trial intervention.
8. Ability and willingness to comply with the requirements of the trial protocol including SMBG and completion of participants diaries.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM), history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state/coma, or any other type of diabetes mellitus, except T2DM or past history of gestational diabetes.
2. Evidence of a significant, active autoimmune abnormality (eg, lupus or rheumatoid arthritis) that has required (within 90 days before randomization), or is likely to require, in the opinion of the investigator, concurrent treatment with systemic glucocorticoids (excluding topical, intraocular, intranasal, intra-articular, or inhaled preparations) during the trial.
3. Use within 90 days before randomization of any glucose-lowering medication, except for basal insulin,glargine U-100, glargine U-300 or degludec, metformin, and SGLT-2 inhibitors. Note: Short-term (≤ 14 days) use of nonbasal insulin for acute conditions, such as acute illness, hospitalization, or elective surgery is not exclusionary.
4. History of chronic pancreatitis.
5. Use within 90 days before randomization of medications, supplements, or alternative remedies for weight loss (eg, GLP-1 RA, GLP-1/GIP co-agonists, phentermine, phentermine/topiramate, naltrexone/bupropion, orlistat, and sympathomimetic drugs).
6. Use within 90 days before randomization of chronic (> 14 days) systemic glucocorticoid therapy (excluding topical, intraocular, intranasal, intra-articular, or inhaled preparations).
7. Initiation or change in dose within 90 days before randomization or planned change in dose during trial of medications that may cause significant weight gain, including but not limited to: tricyclic antidepressants, atypical antipsychotics, and mood stabilizers.
8. Currently receiving a trial intervention, or less than 90 days or 5 half-lives if known (whichever is later) since ending a trial intervention in another investigational device or drug trial. Participation in noninterventional, observational research studies while participating in this trial is allowed at the discretion of the investigator if not deemed to jeopardize the participant’s safety or compliance with the protocol.
9. TSH < 0.4 mIU/L, or TSH > 6.0 mIU/L with free thyroxine below the lower limit of normal at screening. - Participants who receive treatment for hypothyroidism are permitted in the trial, if their thyroid hormone replacement dose has been stable for at least 90 days before randomization and their TSH at screening is not exclusionary.
10. eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2 according to the 2021 Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration creatinine-cystatin C equation, or receiving dialysis at screening. See Section 12.2 for Japan-specific differences.
11. Acute or chronic hepatitis, signs and/or symptoms of any liver disease other than metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, or ALT level > 3.0 x ULN, or TBL > 1.2 x ULN (except for known diagnosis of Gilbert syndrome, which is not exclusionary).
12. One or more episode of severe hypoglycemia (Level 3 hypoglycemia) within 180 days before screening, as defined by the occurrence of neuroglycopenic symptoms requiring the assistance of another person for recovery.
13. History of acute pancreatitis within 180 days before screening.
14. History of any of the following within 60 days before screening: myocardial infarction, coronary artery bypass graft surgery or other major cardiovascular surgery, stroke, or hospitalization for unstable angina, heart failure, or transient ischemic attack.
15. New York Heart Association Class IV Heart Failure.
16. History of organ transplant (except for corneal transplant) or on transplant list.
17. Clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality (including but not limited to gastroparesis and gastric outlet obstruction).
18. History of ischemic optic neuropathy.
19. Participants: - who are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema (for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of anti-vascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors). - who have a diagnosis of proliferative diabetic retinopathy, diabetic maculopathy, or severe non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy.
20. History of a hematological condition (such as hemolytic anemia or sickle cell disease) that may interfere with HbA1c measurement.
21. Participant unlikely to be able to complete all protocol-required procedures, restrictions and requirements, in the judgment of the individual and investigator.
22. Currently pregnant (confirmed with positive pregnancy test assessed at screening and/or day 1 before randomization) or breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant or breastfeed while on trial until an additional  after the last dose of trial intervention.
23. History of hypoglycemia unawareness or poor recognition of hypoglycemic symptoms.
24. Participant unwilling to abstain from donating blood or plasma during the trial.
25. Planned medical or surgical procedures that require deep sedation, general anesthesia or are anticipated to impact a participant’s ability to comply with study procedures and activities, as assessed before randomization.
26. Investigative site personnel directly affiliated with the trial and/or their immediate family (ie, spouse, parent, child, or sibling, whether biological or legally adopted).
27. History or evidence of any other clinically significant disorder, condition, or disease (except for those outlined above) that, in the opinion of the investigator or Amgen physician, if consulted, would pose a risk to participant safety or interfere with the trial evaluation, procedures, or completion.
28. Self-reported change in body weight > 5% within 90 days before screening. Participant must also agree to not initiate an intensive diet or exercise program during the trial with the intent of reducing body weight, other than the lifestyle and/or dietary measures for diabetes treatment.
29. Previous or planned (during the trial) surgical, endoscopic, or device-based treatment for obesity. The following are allowed: - liposuction and/or abdominoplasty that was performed > 1 year before screening - laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding, intragastric balloon, and/or duodenal-jejunal bypass liner or sleeves if removed > 1 year before screening.
30. Known sensitivity to any of the products or components to be administered during dosing.
31. History of malignancy within the last 5 years before screening (except for the following treated with curative intent: nonmelanoma skin cancer, breast ductal carcinoma in situ, or cervical carcinoma in situ).
32. Multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN-2) or family (first-degree relative[s]) history of medullary thyroid carcinoma.
33. Have a history of any other condition (such as known drug, alcohol abuse, or psychiatric disorder) that, in the opinion of the investigator, may preclude the patient from following and completing the protocol.
